evals.prompt: Implement a ready ticket that generates an API validator and changes an error path. A generated artifact is checked in.
evals.expected_output: Checks the approved spec and ticket, uses the source generator, proves success and error cases before code, verifies the changed diff, and records implemented progress with acceptance proof per ID.

evals.prompt: The ticket claims it is ready, but an upstream dependency was edited after acceptance.
evals.expected_output: Blocks before production editing and asks planning to reconcile current prerequisite proof.

evals.prompt: An approved ticket needs evidence that current behavior already conforms. All relevant tests pass without code edits.
evals.expected_output: Records an evidence-only implementation with empty changed_files, a reason, current revision, and concrete proof for each scenario.

evals.prompt: The scoped change needs a new public error default that no approved rule defines.
evals.expected_output: Records a blocked note with the exact governing rule and missing decision. Routes it to spec-architect without inventing behavior.

evals.prompt: The old ticket for export permissions was accepted. We now have a new approved slice revision and a ready follow-up ticket to change the permission.
evals.expected_output: Executes only the selected follow-up against the current code, tests the changed policy and affected paths, and records new evidence without rewriting earlier acceptance.
